root_idea.summary: The root centers on directing oneself or something toward an intended object or course, with related branches involving directness, the middle or just course, and reaching a target.
root_idea.development: Classical lexical development also preserves distinct branches of breaking into pieces and of compactness or fullness; these branches underlie terms for fragments, marrow-rich bodies, and complete poetry, but are not interchangeable with the Quranic meanings of the attested forms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Feminine active-participle inflection of the same Quranic lexical item.

senses.definition: To walk or proceed at a moderate, even pace.
senses.usage_conditions: Quranically used in the command concerning walking: neither too slowly nor too quickly.

senses.definition: Moderate and measured; following a just middle course rather than an extreme.
senses.usage_conditions: An active participle of اقتصد, used of a person or group whose conduct occupies a middle or measured position, including moderation in expenditure and other affairs.

senses.definition: Moderate and easy, of a journey; not difficult or extremely distant.
senses.usage_conditions: Used of a journey that is middling in distance and difficulty; it may consequently be described as near or easy.

senses.definition: The direct or right course; the straight direction of a way.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic expression concerning the way, it denotes the direct or right direction leading toward the truth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tend or direct oneself toward someone or something; make it one's aim; seek, intend, or purpose it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used for directing oneself toward someone with a thing, or for pursuing another person's course or way.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To follow a right or middle course; act justly, equitably, or moderately, avoiding excess and deficiency.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of conduct in affairs, spending, or livelihood; the construction اقْصِدْ بِذَرْعِكَ means to moderate or restrain oneself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Tending or directing oneself; an aim, intention, purpose, or object of pursuit.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The noun may denote either the course or direction taken or what is intended and sought.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Rightness or conformity to the just mean in what is said or done; a right course.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A normative use describing speech, action, or conduct as sound, just, and neither excessive nor deficient.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A little amount that is given.
To be given a little.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive construction describing the recipient of a small amount.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The direction toward someone or something; the course or way pursued.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It can also mean following another person's way or course, doing and thinking as that person does.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Before you; in front of your face.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional adverbial expression, also found with the corresponding nominative form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break a stick or other object, whether generally or into halves.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The breaking may be described without specifying a particular manner.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break many things or break something into many pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived causative/intensive usage associated with breaking into multiple pieces.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Broken, especially of a spear broken in halves or into many pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used adjectivally of a broken spear or similar object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A fragment or piece of a broken thing; a piece of a bone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bone fragment may be specified as roughly a third or quarter, less than half, of the relevant limb or part.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To cause someone or something to tend, turn, aim, seek, or direct its course toward an object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used when an affair or other cause brings about the directing or aiming.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike or hit an object without missing and kill it immediately.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of an arrow, spear, serpent, or destiny when the blow or action proves instantly fatal.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To compose qasidas or continue and prolong the composition of such poems.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A poetic technical usage connected with the noun قَصِيدَة.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To die.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported especially of an animal such as a dog.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break or become broken, including breaking in halves or into pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of objects such as a spear; the form is described as uncommon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: For marrow to become detached or come forth from its place.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used specifically of marrow leaving the place in which it was contained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become fat or full-bodied.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel having compact marrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive bodily or animal term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Aimed at, sought, desired, intended, or purposed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival or participial use describing what is the object of intention or pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Thick or fat marrow; a bone containing marrow; and, by related usage, dry or tough flesh, a plump she-camel, or a fat camel's hump.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reports vary over whether the flesh described is dry and tough or fat; the bodily and animal senses concern compactness or fullness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A staff.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use distinct from the bodily and poetic senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A polished, complete poem or ode, especially one with complete hemistichs and deliberately finished composition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: قَصِيدٌ may function as a collective term for poetry or as a term for an individual qasida; قَصِيدَةٌ is the corresponding unit form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Direct, right, or even, of a road or way; rightly aimed, of an arrow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective describes a road with a direct tendency or an arrow directed correctly toward its target.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Near.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used in the expression for water whose pasture is near.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most direct; more or most right and just.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective used of a road, course, or choice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing that causes people to seek, pursue, or desire it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A noun of cause or object of pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A great and complete woman who pleases everyone who beholds her.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized descriptive usage reported for this feminine noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman inclining to shortness of stature.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported as an alternative form or spelling in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The intended sense or meaning of a saying; an intended or purposed object.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: In مَقْصَدُ الكلام it denotes the intended meaning; it may also denote an object of aim or pursuit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or destination toward which one tends, directs one's course, or aims.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used of the right or intended destinations toward which roads tend.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who falls sick and quickly dies.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare descriptive noun for a person in this condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who composes qasidas or continues and prolongs their composition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A professional or habitual poetic description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person of moderate or middle stature, neither tall nor short and neither corpulent nor thin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily description of balanced or middling build.

cautions: The Quranic verb is presented under the normalized Form I citation headword قَصَدَ rather than the attested imperative surface form ٱقْصِدْ.
The masculine and feminine Quranic forms of مُقْتَصِدٌ are presented together as one active-participle headword; the feminine QAC group is retained in form accounting.
The Quranic قَاصِدٌ sense is specifically the moderate or easy journey usage; other Classical meanings of قَاصِدٌ, such as a direct road or nearness, are kept separate.
The reported short-stature sense of مَقْصَدَةٌ is preserved as a separately attested, variant lexical specialization.
